question: For AMETEK, build a segment revenue trend: report net sales in USD millions for each of its two reportable segments, Electronic Instruments Group (EIG) and Electromechanical Group (EMG), for each of the company's last four reported fiscal quarters as of October 3, 2026 (AMETEK's fiscal year is the calendar year). Label each quarter (e.g., 'Q2 2026') and give its period-end date. Note that fourth-quarter results are not presented in a 10-Q.
grading: Graded cell by cell: each value within tolerance and for the stated period; a missing cell counts as wrong.
answer:

## AMETEK Segment Revenue Trend

**As of October 3, 2026, the last four *reported* fiscal quarters are Q3 2025 through Q2 2026.** AMETEK's Q3 2026 (which ended September 30, 2026) had not yet been reported as of that date — its earnings release came ~Oct 30, 2026 — so Q3 2026 is excluded. (This is also why Q4 2025 appears here: fourth-quarter figures come from the annual 10-K/earnings release, not a 10-Q.)

| Quarter | Period-End Date | EIG Net Sales ($M) | EMG Net Sales ($M) | Consolidated ($M) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Q3 2025 | Sep 30, 2025 | 1,246.3 | 646.3 | 1,892.6 |
| Q4 2025 | Dec 31, 2025 | 1,369.5 | 628.9 | 1,998.4 |
| Q1 2026 | Mar 31, 2026 | 1,264.5 | 663.9 | 1,928.4 |
| Q2 2026 | Jun 30, 2026 | 1,321.2 | 723.2 | 2,044.4 |

Notes:
- Values shown in USD millions (rounded from thousands as reported in AMETEK's financial tables).
- EIG = Electronic Instruments Group; EMG = Electromechanical Group. Consolidated totals include only these two reportable segments.
- Q3 2025 is below Q4 2025 in both EIG and EMG partly due to year-end seasonality/timing; EMG dipped in Q4 2025 before rebounding sharply in Q2 2026 (record $723.2M, +17% YoY).

- Q2 2026: SEC 10-Q (ame-20260630) / Q2 2026 release — https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1037868/000103786826000175/ame-20260630.htm
